name: kamod-motion
description: Preact-first animation primitives for Kamod applications, built on Vanilla Motion.
author: Klaus Zahiragic <watzak>

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "console.error('Do not publish the workspace root. Use: pnpm publish:core'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/motion typecheck && pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/motion build && pnpm -r --filter '!@kamod-ch/motion' typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.qa:package: pnpm --filter @kamod-ch/motion build && pnpm qa:publint && pnpm qa:attw
scripts.qa:release: pnpm qa:package && pnpm qa:size && pnpm qa:import-graph && pnpm qa:tarball
